inputs.coverage: Published Maclaurin model with semiaxes 329, 329, 294 km. The satellite orbit is assumed equatorial. Arbitrary meridian; 11.05 h photometric period has aliases and is not installed as a qualified sidereal spin. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
